job.question: In the Police Retirement System of St. Louis (PRS-STL) actuarial RFP, how many years of experience must the principal actuary have?
job.expected_facts: A minimum of five years of professional actuarial experience, plus a minimum of five years of experience testifying before legislative and administrative bodies.
job.acceptance: Five years professional actuarial experience is the core number. A complete description may state the separate five-year testimony requirement; these are not additive ten years and may overlap. Credentials are optional for this question.

reviews.reason: This is a Hawaii ERS private-equity consultant RFP, not the Police Retirement System of St. Louis actuarial RFP. Its experience requirements concern an investment consultant and do not support the principal-actuary requirement.
quotes: Employees’ Retirement System of the State of Hawaii Request for Proposals Private Equity Consultant Services RFP 2022-04
Offeror has been in business as an investment consultant for a minimum of five years.
The primary consultant assigned to the ERS account has a minimum of seven years experience providing domestic and international investment consulting services to public pension plans.
